mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 37 degrees under overcast skies near Reddan Soccer Park. We have a Waning Gibbous moon out there, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight will dip down to a low of 31 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the upcoming 2027 Spring Election, where seats in all four Aldermanic Districts will be on the ballot. If you are interested, remember that all necessary forms must be filed with the City Clerk at 111 Lincoln Street by 5 PM on January 5, 2027.

We have plenty of activities to keep you busy, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness and ART House 360 Thursday Nights happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to Hop Haus Trivia, live music at Bailey's Run, and a celebration of 50 years of craft brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a notable incident on November 6, officers responded to a business in the 500 block of West Verona Avenue where a woman was found slumped over in her vehicle; she was later arrested for O W I.
Today's flavor of the day has concluded as the store is now closed for the evening. We look forward to serving you tomorrow starting at 10 AM when we will be featuring the Snickers Swirl.
